note: Rustic campground of Waterloo Recreation Area (Michigan DNR) on Green Lake, entered from M-52 about 5 miles north of I-94 exit 159 (18500 N M-52, Chelsea, per the DNR directions). Near the DTE Energy Foundation Trail, the Waterloo-Pinckney Trail and the Border-to-Border Trail; accessible boat launch; one heated yurt. Quiet wooded setting. --Claude
summary: DNR park page + rates table + directions PDF + MiDNRReservations: $20 (confirmed, 2027), no electric, vault toilets, hand pump (confirmed), count changed 25 -> 24, max length changed 30 -> 45 ft (22 of 24 take 23 ft), reservable (confirmed) with reservation season Apr 1 - Nov 29 (confirmed, derived -> manual). No operating-season statement. Pin sits on the south shore of Green Lake (OSM 'Green Lake Rustic Campground' 42.3645,-84.0713), about 4 km from the Horsemen's campground on Loveland Road - this is not the equestrian camp.
